The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) invites applications from exceptional candidates for biomedical sciences faculty positions (Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor) for its new School of Medicine.
The University
HKUST is a dynamic young University with a global reputation for impact and innovation. Founded in 1991, HKUST is consistently ranked among the world’s best institutions and 1st in Hong Kong for graduate employability.
As a world-renowned international research and interdisciplinary University with top-tier programs in science, engineering, business and management, humanities and social science, and interdisciplinary studies, HKUST is known for its entrepreneurial culture and powerful connections to industry and research. The University’s English-speaking academic community thrives in a world-class, scenic environment at the Clear Water Bay campus.
HKUST’s pioneering spirit is amplified through the “Unified HKUST, Complementary Campuses” framework, expanded by the opening of the innovative HKUST(Guangzhou) campus in 2022, which deepens its interdisciplinary reach into the Greater Bay Area and beyond.
For more information about HKUST, please visit: https://hkust.edu.hk .
The HKUST School of Medicine
HKUST is embarking on a landmark initiative to establish the third medical school of Hong Kong following the successful proposal of the University and subsequent official approval from the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government.
The HKUST School of Medicine aspires to be a transformative force, focused on world-class education and research while attracting global talents. By integrating cutting-edge technology and pioneering science, the School will help shape the future of medicine and reinforce Hong Kong’s position as an international hub for medical training, research, and innovation.
Built upon HKUST’s interdisciplinary strengths, deeply international character, and global networks, the School will foster a world-class learning environment. As a leader in fields such as artificial intelligence, data science, and robotics, HKUST is uniquely positioned to create a medical school that fuses exceptional clinical expertise with technological innovation. Its mission is to cultivate future-ready physicians who are not only clinically outstanding but also technologically adept, innovative, and compassionate. The School will launch a 4-year graduate-entry Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) program, with global admissions opening by 2027 and the inaugural class expected to commence in the 2028/29 academic year.
The School will initially operate in a dedicated new medical teaching and research building at the Clear Water Bay campus, along with satellite site(s) close to a teaching hospital partner. Its long-term future includes a transition to a permanent, integrated campus and medical teaching and research hospital within Hong Kong's strategic Northern Metropolis, placing it at the center of the dynamic Greater Bay Area innovation ecosystem.
About the Roles
We invite applications from outstanding individuals with a strong commitment to both research and medical education. Appointees will contribute to pre-clinical teaching and postgraduate supervision, alongside a vibrant research program that advances biomedical science and its application to medicine.
We offer a dynamic and collaborative environment with state-of-the-art facilities, fostering excellence and innovation in advancing healthcare. Faculty members will have ample opportunities to develop cutting-edge curricula, engage in pioneering research, and shape the future of medical practice in the region.
Candidates
Applicants should have:
A PhD and/or MD degree in biology, biomedical sciences, medicine, or a closely related area.
A strong track record in both research and teaching, with demonstrated excellence in the relevant area.
A demonstrated commitment to knowledge exchange, teamwork, and international engagement.
Experience in medical education will be viewed favorably.
Applicants for Professor or Associate Professor should have substantial experience and a distinguished record of research excellence and academic leadership. A strong record of publication in leading journals and success in obtaining competitive external funding are expected. Applicants with less experience will be considered for Assistant Professor positions.
Terms of Appointment
Appointment as Professor will be on a substantive (tenured) basis. Initial appointment for Associate Professor / Assistant Professor will normally be on a 3-year contract, renewable subject to mutual agreement. Strong candidates applying for an Associate Professor position may be considered for appointment on substantive terms.
A highly competitive salary commensurate with qualifications and experience will be offered. Fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, and housing benefits (where applicable).
Application Procedure
Interested candidates should apply online ( https://hkustcareers.ust.hk ), submitting: (a) an up-to-date curriculum vitae; (b) a one-page summary describing their most outstanding accomplishments and qualifications; (c) a statement of teaching philosophy; (d) a one-page description of their future research and career plan; and (e) the names and contact details of three referees (including email addresses).
Review of applications will begin immediately until the positions are filled.
(Information provided by applicants will be used for recruitment and other employment-related purposes. Applicants should read the Personal Information Collection Statement ( https://hro.hkust.edu.hk/rcpics ) before submission of application.)
HKUST is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to our core values of
inclusiveness, diversity, and respect.

The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) established the Division of Arts ad Machine Creativity (AMC) in July 2024 under the Academy of Interdisciplinary Studies (AIS), the fifth school of HKUST. As an interdisciplinary academic unit, AMC aims to be a leading center where technology, art, and humanities converge to drive creativity and innovation. We are seeking a high-caliber academic administrator to lead this new Division as the Founding Head.
The Role
Reporting to the Dean of AIS, the Founding Head will provide leadership and manage the Division's academic and administrative functions. Key responsibilities include advancing interdisciplinary teaching and research, faculty recruitment, and resource management. The Head will also develop strategies to promote the Division and facilitate interdisciplinary collaboration within HKUST and externally with arts organizations, as well as private, governmental, and non-governmental entities.
The Candidate
Applicants should be distinguished scholars or artists with outstanding academic and/or professional accomplishments, consistent with an appointment as Full Professor with tenure or equivalent. While a background in the arts is preferred, expertise in art technology and other related areas will be considered. Prior administrative experience is highly desirable. Candidates should demonstrate proven leadership, managerial capabilities, experience in leading collaborative programs, and success in securing external funding. The ability to engage effectively with arts organizations, government, industry, and commercial sectors is advantageous.
The Division
The Division of Arts and Machine Creativity (AMC) is an interdisciplinary academic unit envisioned as a pioneering center where technology, art, and humanities drive creativity and innovation. This initiative fosters a fusion of innovation and humanities, supporting HKUST’s Strategic Plan 2031 as a major effort to expand academic frontiers through, aiming to lead positive changes in education and research, and empower the next generation to address global challenges.
The mission of the Division includes:
Bridging the gap between technology and art, by providing students and researchers with professional education and robust environment.
Cultivating artistic and creative talents equipped with the skills and knowledge to leverage emerging technologies such as AI and machine learning.
Fostering a cross-disciplinary environment that empowers collaboration and innovation among artists and technologists.
Developing cutting-edge, interdisciplinary research and education programs in partnership with other institutions in the fields of arts and machine learning
AMC’s focus areas include: (a) digital art practice (including visual, sound, performing, installation, cinematic arts); (b) machine creativity; (c) art management covering managerial, legal, and business topics related to AI arts, NFT, etc.; and (d) critical studies examining art history, media theory, and philosophy of technology in the context of arts and machine creativity. The Division will offer graduate degree programs, including MA and MFA programs, as well as MPhil/PhD programs. It will also provide common core courses for all undergraduates at HKUST, and potentially undergraduate programs in future. The Division will collaborate with the Computational Media and Arts Thrust of HKUST(GZ) to advance scientific research in artificial intelligence in generative creativity and machine creativity.
The University
Founded in 1991, HKUST is a world-renowned international research university dedicated to the advancement of learning, research, scholarship, and the education of a new generation of elite students through top-tier programs in science, engineering, business & management, humanities & social science, and interdisciplinary studies.
HKUST is deeply committed to advancing humanities and arts education and research. The School of Humanities and Social Science offers diverse music and creative writing courses led by distinguished artists and active practitioners. Courses include “Music of the World”, “Introduction to Music Composition”, and “Chinese Creative Writing”, fostering creativity and collaboration. Additionally, film courses like “Independent Cinema in Contemporary China” are offered, broadening students' artistic perspectives.
Since it was founded 33 years ago, HKUST has already established a strong presence in global higher education and received a number of international recognitions. Among others, HKUST was ranked No.3 in the Times Higher Education’s Young University Rankings 2024, 12 of its subjects were ranked among the world’s top 50 in the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2024. While the University is deeply rooted in Hong Kong, HKUST (GZ) in Guangzhou, Mainland China complements the well-established disciplinary foundation at the Hong Kong campus with 4 transdisciplinary hubs and 16 thrust areas. We are dedicated to educating well-rounded students with strong entrepreneurial spirits and innovative and globally oriented thinking. English is the medium of teaching, research, and administration at HKUST. HKUST promotes diversity with an inclusive and collaborative community and the use of modern instructional methods.
Terms & Applications
The appointment will be concurrent with a substantive professorial appointment. The headship will be a full-time appointment for an initial term of three years, and renewable for another term, subject to further review. HKUST provides competitive remuneration and generous fringe benefits, including housing where appropriate.
Application, including a curriculum vitae, a vision statement, as well as names and email addresses of at least three referees, should be sent to the AMC Head Search Committee (c/o Academy of Interdisciplinary Studies), the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Clearwater Bay, Kowloon, Hong Kong (or by email: amcdhsearch@ust.hk ). Review of applications will begin from early December 2024 and continue until the position is filled.
For more information about the University, the Academy of Interdisciplinary Studies and the AMC Division, please visit https://hkust.edu.hk/ and https://ais.hkust.edu.hk/ respectively.

• supports each awardee with a full-time appointment as Postdoctoral Fellow (PdF) at the supporting university for a period of 24 months, with an optional extension to 36 months upon request, and

d) fringe benefits include annual leave, medical and dental benefits, mandatory provident fund, gratuity and incoming passage and baggage allowance for the eligible appointees.

Applicants should have obtained/ been conferred a PhD degree or an equivalent qualification on or after 1 January 2023 (i.e. not more than three years before 2026), or will complete the requirement of a PhD degree or an equivalent qualification by 31 August 2027 .

Our Faculty of Science has been renamed to Faculty of Science and Technology with effect from 1 September 2026. The renaming reaffirms our Faculty’s commitment to a technology-integrated vision which is essential to our continued success.

The appointee will be expected to conduct independent, high-quality research, foster interdisciplinary collaborations, and demonstrate research achievements of originality and depth. The ideal candidate will have the potential to become a leading international scholar and contribute to impactful research and innovative technological applications.

The Faculty of Arts and Humanities at UOW College Hong Kong offers a diverse range of academic programmes, including two bachelor’s degree programmes, four associate degree programmes, and one diploma programme. Our faculty is a hub of intellectual curiosity and critical inquiry, offering a diverse range of programmes that prepare students for the challenges and opportunities of the 21st century. Developing course materials;
Marking assignments and assessment scripts; and
Performing other related teaching and administrative duties.

a degree in any disciplines;
